title: Amazon Web Services IAM user secret access key: one-property twin (length) (tool-corroborated) [legacy tier T2]
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 39 vs contracted 40. Twin of "Amazon Web Services IAM user secret access key: must be flagged (project-policy) [legacy tier T3]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of aws-secret-access-key-key-shape-bare: length: 39 vs contracted 40. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
